entities.summary: Kenneth Mark Holland is a Canadian ice hockey executive and former goaltender, and is currently serving as the vice president and general manager of the Los Angeles Kings in the National Hockey League. Holland most notably served as the executive vice president and general manager of the Detroit Red Wings of the National Hockey League from 1997 to 2019, winning four Stanley Cup championships. He then served as president of hockey operations and general manager of the Edmonton Oilers from 2019 to 2024, with the Oilers reaching the 2024 Stanley Cup Final.
